# Cardenza (鸣片)

> The Cardenza is 203 Systems' pocket synthesizer: an ESP32-S3 with 56 keys that light up, a 240 × 135 colour
> screen, a speaker, a microphone, an SD card and USB. It ships with the 203 Launcher, which installs firmware from
> the 203 community by a six-character code. This site (cardenza.203.io) is its user's guide and manual; the
> community is at https://cardenza.203.io/community.

## Making firmware for the Cardenza

- The firmware SDK is CardenzaHAL, an ESP-IDF component: https://github.com/203-Systems/CardenzaHAL (its README lists
  the hardware and the header that drives each part).
- 203-CLI (`203c`), the community's command line and an Agent Skill, is required: it makes the project, installs a
  build on a Cardenza over USB through the Launcher, reads its log and publishes it, and a firmware on CardenzaHAL does
  not build without it. Install it first (Node.js 18+, any OS): `npm install -g 203c && 203c skill install`; cloning
  https://github.com/203-Systems/203-CLI does not install it.
- The rules for every step, for people and AI agents alike (one Markdown file):
  https://cardenza.203.io/community/develop.md; the developer guide: https://cardenza.203.io/community/develop.
- The community's API and what 203c does: https://cardenza.203.io/community/llms.txt.
- Never `idf.py flash` a Cardenza: it erases the 203 Launcher. Install through it (`203c flash --bin build/<project>.bin`).
- The official firmware, Cardenza Synth (code V6QK28), is the largest example: https://github.com/203-Systems/CardenzaSynth.
- Schematic and PCB model: https://github.com/203-Systems/Cardenza-Hardware.

## Using the Cardenza

- Guide (short lessons): https://cardenza.203.io/
- Manual: https://cardenza.203.io/manual/start/
- Browser simulator: https://cardenza-synth.vercel.app/
